answer: An agent marketplace serving ivory appraisers, lotus growers, and tide forecasters requires each seller identity to lock a $1,000 bond for 30 days before accepting jobs. Each identity can hold at most $500 in unfinished contracts, and verifiable non-delivery forfeits its bond. An attacker creating 1,000 fake sellers must immobilize $1 million, while the contract cap keeps the proceeds from a coordinated default below the bonds at risk.
